failures.claim: Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included in sustainability-related financial disclosures by cross-reference to another report published by the entity, and if cross-referenced the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B45–B47.

warnings.claim: A complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures presents fairly all sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.

Fair presentation requires disclosure of relevant information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities and faithful representation in accordance with IFRS S1, providing a complete, neutral and accurate depiction.
Fair presentation requires information that is comparable, verifiable, timely and understandable.
To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B1–B12.
In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the entity applies IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
The entity discloses material information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
To identify and disclose material information, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B13–B37.
The sustainability-related financial disclosures are for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.

The entity provides information in a manner that enables users to understand connections between items, including connections between various sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.

The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections within the sustainability-related financial disclosures, including connections between governance, strategy, risk management and metrics and targets disclosures.

The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections across sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports published by the entity, such as the related financial statements.
The entity identifies the financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate.
When currency is specified as the unit of measure in sustainability-related financial disclosures, the entity uses the presentation currency of its related financial statements.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor and manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about strategy (the approach used to manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities).

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about risk management processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about metrics and targets, including performance and progress towards targets set by the entity or required by law or regulation.

In identifying applicable disclosure requirements about a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to that risk or opportunity.
In addition to IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the disclosure topics in the SASB Standards.

In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies, the entity applies judgement to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
In making the judgement described in IFRS S1.57, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the metrics associated with the disclosure topics included in the SASB Standards.

Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included in sustainability-related financial disclosures by cross-reference to another report published by the entity, and if cross-referenced the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B45–B47.
